description: A Java class named EngineReport that models a digital signal represented as a sequence of UpDown objects, providing parsing, comparison, and time mapping functionalities for engine waveform data.

classes.name: EngineReport
classes.description: A model representing a sequence of digital signals (UpDown objects) with parsing and time mapping capabilities.

classes.name: EngineReport.UpDown
classes.description: Represents a pair of up and down times in systicks, with methods to compute duration and duty cycle based on engine logs.

methods.name: EngineReport
methods.description: Constructor to create an EngineReport instance from a report string or a list of UpDown objects.

methods.name: EngineReport.isCloseEnough
methods.description: Checks if two values are within a specified ratio threshold.

methods.name: EngineReport.parse
methods.description: Parses a report string into a list of UpDown objects, handling specific formatting.

methods.name: EngineReport.getList
methods.description: Returns the list of UpDown objects.

methods.name: EngineReport.getMaxTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum timestamp in systicks.

methods.name: EngineReport.getMinTime
methods.description: Returns the minimum timestamp in systicks.

methods.name: EngineReport.getDuration
methods.description: Returns the total duration of the report in systicks.

methods.name: EngineReport.timeToScreen
methods.description: Converts a time in systicks to a screen x-coordinate based on width.

methods.name: EngineReport.screenToTime
methods.description: Converts a screen x-coordinate to a timestamp in systicks.
